report.answer_text:
The Oklahoma City Thunder won the 2025 NBA championship. They beat the Indiana Pacers in seven games.[1] The Thunder won Game 7 by 103–91 at Paycom Center.[2] It was the franchise's first NBA championship[3] in Oklahoma City.
Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was Finals MVP. He averaged 30.3 points, 4.6 rebounds and 5.6 assists in the series.[4] He was the first Canadian to win the award.[1] He also became the fourth player in NBA history to win the league MVP, Finals MVP and scoring title in the same season.[5]
